title: Furniture Store Franchise Opportunity
name: Licht Möbel, 1 Franchisee, Est'd in 1985, Ebikon HQ
description: Licht Möbel is a Swiss furniture and kitchen brand based in Ebikon, near Lucerne, operated by LiCHter Grosshändler GmbH. - The company is seeking franchise and business partners across Europe, the Balkans, and the Middle East/GCC to expand its presence through a retail partnership model. - Offers the Licht Möbel Studio concept, requiring a minimum space of 80 m², designed as a shop-in-shop within existing furniture or kitchen stores. - Owns an approximately 20,000 m² factory and brings over 40 years of furniture manufacturing experience, managing production and distribution in-house. - Offers made-to-measure furniture and kitchens, along with a complete living range covering bedroom, living, dining, upholstery, and kitchen solutions. - Partners advise customers, plan designs, and manage sales, while the company handles manufacturing and provides delivery and installation support. - The partnership model includes no entry fee, trade margins of 35% or more, territorial exclusivity, display collections at partner prices, 3D planning tools, catalogues, price lists, and an online ordering system. - Partners receive training at the company's flagship showroom in Switzerland, joint online marketing support, and factory-backed delivery and installation assistance. - Differentiates itself through factory-direct pricing, made-to-measure products, Swiss brand and service standards, and a broad furniture offering from a single source. - Offers B2B opportunities serving hotels, serviced apartments, Airbnb operators, restaurants, and real estate developers, alongside retail customers. - Provides a two-year warranty on all products and operates from its flagship showroom in Ebikon, Switzerland. - Holds VAT registration and is seeking partners to establish and grow the Licht Möbel brand in new territories.
